name: Easy Moroccan-Spiced Dutch Oven Chicken, Potatoes & Cauliflower with Apricots

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
While the Dutch oven heats up, place spices in a medium bowl and stir to combine the rub. Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl, and use your hands to thoroughly coat with the spice rub.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp garam masala
1 tbsp cumin, ground
2 tsp salt
1 tsp black pepper
1.36 kg chicken thighs, bone-in skin-on

instructions.primary_message: Once the Dutch oven is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add chicken and sear until golden, 2-3 minutes per side (the chicken won't be fully cooked). Remove to a plate. (Reserve Dutch oven with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, zest, and juice orange into a small bowl. Wash and dry new potatoes. Set both aside.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion.
Return Dutch oven (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, then add onion, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp minced garlic
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is done, return chicken (and any accumulated juices) to the Dutch oven along with orange zest, juice, potatoes, apricots, broth, and cauliflower. Stir to combine (don't worry if it isn't all mixed together), cover, and place in the oven. Bake until chicken is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 1 1/2-2 hours. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 (283 g) bag cauliflower florets

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken, veggies, apricots, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
